defaults.instructions:
1. This is a video series that follows a group of friends/content creators competitive Fantasy Football league. The league takes place during an individual NFL season. There is a playoff tournament at the end of each "season", ultimately resulting in a championship winner. There is also an Ultimate Loser of each season, who faces a special punishment before the start of the following season. Each new season starts fresh, coinciding with the start of the next NFL season. The inaugural season took place during the 2024-25 NFL season.
2. Reference a generic Fantasy Football PPR ruleset to understand how the game is played.
3. The narrative importance should be placed primarily on the "Team Owners" rather than the NFL athletes. For example, if noting that NFL athlete Puka Nacua is injured during Week 1, it is important to note who is the Team Owner with Puka Nacua on their team.
4. Team names (e.g. "StevenSwagal") may change week-to-week but Team Owner (e.g. "Tom") should remain static. Therefore, it is best to use the Team Owner name rather than the Team name in all notes.
5. Track as many details of who wins head-to-head matchups (including the score) each week, but note that the full details of every matchup are not always available for a given week due to how the videos are selectively edited.
6. Always make note of mentioned injuries, trades, and waiver wire actions.
7. Be concise in the note-taking; wordiness is not a virtue.
8. Make note of any "items requiring review" for each episode so that the human (me) can review your uncertainties and potentially add more guidance.
9. YouTube transcripts can be used as a supplement but note that they are not 100% accurate. If ever noticing a discrepancy between transcripted text and what appears on-screen, defer to on-screen content.

events.summary: Entering Week 13, Zach leads the league at 9-3, while Bush is in 12th/last at 4-8 on a four-game losing streak.

evidence.details: Standings display and narration show Zach at 9-3 and Bush in last at 4-8; Bush states he is on a four-game losing streak.

events.summary: The league is tightly clustered: the hosts say 11 of 12 teams are in the postseason or one game back with two regular-season games remaining.

facts.name: playoff-race context
facts.value: 11 of 12 teams are in a playoff position or one game back

evidence.details: Host describes the league-wide playoff race and notes two games remain.

events.summary: Upcoming Week 13 matchup: Mason vs. Nathan.

evidence.details: The host identifies Mason as facing Nathan.

events.summary: Mason and Nathan accepted a Week 13 wager: the loser of their matchup must wear a turkey hat in the following week’s midweek video.

facts.name: wager consequence
facts.value: Matchup loser wears a turkey hat

evidence.details: Mason proposes the turkey-hat consequence and Nathan explicitly accepts.
Mason restates that the loser must wear the hat in next week's midweek video.

events.summary: Avery added Devaughn Vele for $32 FAAB and dropped Kayshon Boutte.

evidence.details: Waiver-processing screen lists Avery adding Vele for $32 and dropping Boutte.
Avery says he won Vele and spent $32.

events.summary: Upcoming Week 13 matchup: Danny vs. Badake. The episode frames it as pivotal to both owners’ playoff hopes.

facts.name: conditional implication
facts.value: A Danny loss would leave Danny 6-7 and move Badake to 6-7, as discussed

evidence.details: Commentary identifies Danny versus Badake and gives conditional record implications; matchup screen corroborates the pairing.

events.summary: Breece Hall reportedly missed Wednesday practice after the bye because of knee soreness; Danny’s fantasy plans are affected and Hall’s Sunday availability is uncertain.

facts.name: reported practice status
facts.value: Did not practice Wednesday following bye

evidence.details: Danny discusses Hall's Wednesday DNP and the possibility that he may not play Sunday.

events.summary: A last-place manager, referred to in speech as “Bo,” reportedly added Braelon Allen before Danny could acquire him after the Breece Hall news.

facts.name: waiver context
facts.value: Reportedly added after Breece Hall's DNP news and ahead of Danny

facts.name: manager identity
facts.value: Spoken as 'Bo'; owner mapping is unresolved

evidence.details: Danny says the last-place team picked up Braelon Allen just before he reached waivers.

events.summary: Danny says he offered Buccaneers D/ST plus a receiver for Braelon Allen, but the other manager wanted a starting running back; no completed trade is established.

facts.name: Danny offer
facts.value: Buccaneers D/ST plus a receiver for Braelon Allen

evidence.details: Danny describes his offer and says the manager would only move Allen for a starting running back.

events.summary: Upcoming Week 13 matchup: Sal vs. Avery. Avery is projected for 136.30 points (60%) to Sal’s 122.52 (40%).

evidence.details: Matchup screen and dialogue identify Sal versus Avery and display the projections and probabilities.

events.summary: A trade proposal shown on the league platform was rejected: zaxavage would receive Josh Allen from GreenMeansMoney for Baker Mayfield, Terry McLaurin, and Jonathan Taylor.

facts.name: Austin players named by Bush
